title: Longer-term Paid Internship or Apprenticeship Programmes for Fresh Graduates in Sectors Affected by AI Adoption
what_it_is: Longer-term Paid Internship or Apprenticeship Programmes for Fresh Graduates in Sectors Affected by AI Adoption

sections.label: Paid internships for fresh graduates
sections.summary: A question asks whether the Ministry will work with employers on longer-term paid internship or apprenticeship programmes for fresh graduates in affected sectors.

sentences.text: The following question stood in the name of  Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry –   18 To ask the Acting Minister for Manpower in light of the recent workforce restructuring across industries and the growing adoption of AI, whether the Ministry will consider working with employers to develop longer-term paid internship or apprenticeship programmes for fresh graduates in affected sectors to help them gain meaningful initial work experience.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Manpower (Ms Jasmin Lau)
sentences.text: This question has been addressed by the reply to Question No 59 on the Order Paper for 4 August 2026.

sections.label: GRIT traineeship outcomes
sections.summary: A question asks if the Ministry will publish GRIT trainees' employment, wage and job relevance outcomes, and the reply says outcomes will be shared at a suitable juncture.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: More than 550 graduates have entered GRIT, which is encouraging.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: As the first cohort completes their traineeships, will the Ministry of Manpower publish their permanent employment conversion, wage, job relevance outcomes at the six- or 12 month marks, and explain which results will justify moving towards longer apprenticeships?

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: There are still many GRIT trainees in the process of completing their traineeships.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: I think at a suitable juncture we will definitely share the outcomes with the public.
